howItWorks.title: How LabelLens AI Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A step-by-step overview of our deterministic package screening pipeline from raw label capture to visual evidence grounding and officer triage.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Product package label image is captured via live camera or uploaded as a digital image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC).
howItWorks.step1Detail: Supports multi-panel capture including front, back, and side product surfaces.
howItWorks.step2Desc: RapidOCR engine detects raw text blocks across package panels and generates 4-point bounding box pixel coordinates.
howItWorks.step2Detail: Execution runs on lightweight ONNX runtime engine without external cloud API dependencies.
howItWorks.step3Desc: The extraction service parses OCR bounding box lines to extract mandatory product declarations.
howItWorks.step3Detail: Identifies MRP, Net Quantity, Manufacturer / Packer Details, Dates (Mfg/Expiry/Pack), Consumer Care, and FSSAI information.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Deterministic rule evaluation checks extracted fields against Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
howItWorks.step4Detail: Screens for mandatory presence, unit formatting, manufacturer address completeness, and date legibility.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Every extracted declaration and finding is directly mapped to its exact visual bounding box on the original package image.
howItWorks.step5Detail: Eliminates unexplainable AI outputs by making every finding 100% auditable and visually verifiable.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Automated screening flags ambiguous or unverified items for authorized enforcement officer review.
howItWorks.step6Detail: Officers can confirm compliance, request manual field inspection, or ask for a clearer image capture.
howItWorks.step7Desc: Generates an official inspection PDF summary report containing extracted fields, Rule 6 audit findings, and timestamped log.
howItWorks.step7Detail: PDF reports can be downloaded and attached to physical enforcement case files.
howItWorks.whyApproachDesc: Rationale behind our deterministic, evidence-grounded screening system design.
howItWorks.point1Desc: RapidOCR extracts raw text and 4-point pixel coordinates without making compliance assumptions.
howItWorks.point2Desc: Extraction service parses raw OCR text into standardized fields (MRP, Net Quantity, Dates, Manufacturer).
howItWorks.point3Desc: Deterministic Legal Metrology Rule 6 validation engine evaluates extracted values against statutory standards.
howItWorks.point4Desc: Every declaration links directly to its bounding box on the original package image for instant verification.
howItWorks.safeguard: Human-in-the-loop safeguard: Unclear or ambiguous findings are flagged for human review rather than guessing compliance.

about.title: LABEL LENS AI
about.subtitle: Autonomous verification and statutory compliance screening for packaged commodities under the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
about.workflowSubtitle: How LABEL LENS AI processes physical packages from raw pixels to verified statutory verdicts.
about.charterDesc: Under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, pre-packaged commodities sold in India must bear mandatory declarations in prescribed font sizes, formats, and positions.
about.ruleADesc: Generic or common name of the commodity contained in package.
about.ruleBDesc: Full name, registered office address, and country of origin if imported.
about.ruleCDesc: Declared in standard units of weight, volume, or count with units.
about.ruleDDesc: Maximum Retail Price (incl. of all taxes) and month/year of manufacture.
